subject: Purchase order constraints, invoice cadence & payment rail question

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@asterhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@asterhealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format and invoice cadence for 2027 onboarding

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Aster Health is excited about Redwood for inference across our analytics workloads. Procurement wants to confirm a couple of constraints before we kick off the SOW:

1) PO requirements: our AP system requires a single purchase order per fiscal quarter for platform usage (we prefer a blanket PO with quarterly release). We can supply a PDF-formatted PO; can Redwood accept PO numbers in the invoice header and a separate "bill-to" entity for US operations?
2) Net terms: standard is Net 45 for our contracts; we can request Net 30 if needed but that requires a billing policy exception.
3) Invoice cadence & payment rail: we do weekly/biweekly remittance but our ERP prefers the invoice to include the PO reference and a charge breakdown by month.

Attached is a sample PO and a simple timing matrix for how our billing team expects to receive invoices. Can you confirm whether Redwood can map PO -> invoice header, support quarter-based blanket POs, and whether early-pay discounts are on the table (we've budgeted for a small early-pay incentive if available)?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can move the purchase request forward.

Best,
Samantha Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Aster Health

Attachments: Aster_PO_sample.pdf (PDF, 45KB), invoice_timing_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@asterhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and invoice cadence for 2027 onboarding

Hi Samantha — thanks for sharing the sample PO and the cadence matrix. Quick answers below; looping in Ben from Billing and Grace on commercial.

1) PO mapping: Yes — Redwood can accept a blanket PO. We require the PO number present on the invoice header and we can include a separate bill-to entity field. We do sometimes need the PO to reference the subscription/contract ID (we'll provide the mapping).

2) Net terms: Our default for hosted customers is Net 30. Net 45 is possible but typically triggers a credit review for larger commitments. If Aster wants Net 45, we'll need AP onboarding evidence (entity docs) and a signed credit addendum.

3) Invoice cadence / breakdown: We can emit invoices that break charges by month and include PO references. For weekly/biweekly remittance, we support weekly statements but invoices must still map to a monthly charge bucket for our revenue system. If Aster needs invoice-drip (weekly invoices tied to a single PO), we can support it for enterprise customers but need a short implementation window (7–10 business days) to set up PO mapping and ERP fields.

Regarding early-pay discounts: Grace — what levers do we have for a small early-pay incentive on a quarterly blanket PO?

Mina
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Aster_PO_sample.pdf, invoice_timing_matrix.xlsx

Hi all,

Ben from Billing Ops here — thanks for the clear sample, Samantha. A few operational notes and constraints:

- PO header field: We will need the PO number in the invoice top-right header ("PO#: 12345"). If your ERP includes multiple PO line items, please indicate which SKU(s) map to Redwood usage (we have SKU mapping guidance if needed).
- Blanket/quarterly PO: We can accept a blanket PO with quarterly releases, but each quarterly invoice must contain an internal contract reference (we will provide) and the billing period (e.g., Q1 2027).
- Invoice-drip: For weekly invoices tied to a single PO, we can send weekly invoices, but reconciliation requires a consistent line-item reference and an agreed metadata field (we typically use "customer_reference"). We charge an operational setup fee ($500) to enable invoice-drip and custom metadata in our billing pipeline unless the account meets reserved capacity thresholds.
- Net terms: We can set Net 45 on the billing account after credit onboarding. If Aster prefers Net 45 without credit evidence, we can accommodate for the first quarter with prepayment or a short-term holdback.

Samantha — if you can confirm whether Aster will: (A) accept the $500 setup fee for weekly invoices, or (B) accept monthly invoices broken down by month (no fee), we can scope the billing configuration. Also, what is the expected quarterly spend? That affects whether the setup fee is waivable.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing_field_spec.pdf (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@asterhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and invoice cadence for 2027 onboarding

Hi Samantha — Grace on Commercial. Appreciate the detail — happy to make a commercial accommodation here. Proposed options: 

Option A (preferred for both sides):
- Quarterly blanket PO with monthly invoices (no operational fee).
- Net 45 for the billing account after we complete a standard credit onboarding (we'll pause collections until evidence is received; typical turnaround 5 business days).
- Early-pay incentive: 1.5% discount if Aster pays within 10 days of invoice. Discount applies to invoices for the first two quarters as a pilot.

Option B (if Aster requires weekly invoices):
- Weekly invoice-drip tied to the blanket PO with $500 one-time setup fee (waived if committed quarterly spend >= $75k).
- Net 30 only (Net 45 still requires credit onboarding). No early-pay discount when on weekly-drip due to reconciliation costs.

Next steps: pick A or B and provide confirmation of expected quarterly spend and the legal entity for the PO. Mina/Ben — I'll approve waivers if spend meets threshold. Samantha — once we have confirmation, I'll attach a short addendum to the order form outlining the discount and invoicing cadence.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
